This project is a professional registration system built with React and TypeScript. It features:
- A landing page with a CAPTCHA puzzle for bot verification.
- A Gmail-style registration/sign-in page with modern UI and smooth transitions.
- All code should follow best practices for accessibility, responsiveness, and security.
- Use functional components and React Router for navigation.
- Use TypeScript for type safety throughout the codebase.
- Prioritize clean, maintainable, and scalable code.
